name: IVT_F
use: Forward - anneals to the forward handle on every construct

name: IVT_R_plain
use: Reverse without tail - colony PCR and sequencing checks. NOTE: you will NOT find this sequence in gblocks.fasta, and that is correct. A reverse primer anneals to the top strand, so what appears in the fragment is its reverse complement - the last 20 nt of every fragment, GTCATGCAGTCGATCACTGA.

name: IVT_R_polyA120
use: Reverse with a 120-nt poly(T) 5' tail - adds the poly(A) to the IVT template. Order as an Ultramer or equivalent. Only the 3' 20 nt anneal; the T120 tail hangs off the template and is copied into the product, which is why the fragment encodes no poly(A).
